viewport_notes: mobile: tap-targets ≥44px, no overflow past 375px, text not tiny. desktop: grid alignment.

checks.rule: no spacing collisions or overlapping elements; nothing wraps or overflows the viewport (flex rows, long text); typography cascade intact (no wrong font/size/weight bleeding into a section); if the surface renders dark, text stays readable
no element bleeds past the viewport right edge; no sideways scroll
one clear hero headline + a clear primary CTA; reads top-to-bottom
deliberate, consistent section gaps on the locked scale; no cramped collisions, no desolate voids (esp. above the footer)
text/image/CTA align to one grid, not a left+center hybrid
no grey/missing-image placeholders, no Liquid errors, no empty section shells, no Lorem/[CLAIM]/placeholder text
cookie/consent/announcement chrome matches the brand (not default system black/white) and is a slim non-blocking bar, not a centered overlay covering content
homepage section order matches the niche recipe (hero → proof → product → editorial → newsletter); no section out of its recipe position
intentional premium brand per the niche premium scorecard, not a generic theme demo
